origin.description: Unpacks a vector into a symmetric matrix.

arguments.name: diag
arguments.text: True means vec includes the diagonal. False leaves the diagonal as missing.

arguments.name: order
arguments.text: A 1-based permutation applied before the fill. Omitted keeps vec as given.

origin.details: The length must be a triangular number. The lower triangle is filled column by column and copied to the upper triangle.
